poster_title: ShadowFormer: Global Context Helps Image Shadow Removal

sections.title: ShadowFormer: Global Context Helps Image Shadow Removal
sections.content_md:
ShadowFormer: Global Context Helps Image Shadow Removal

Lanqing Guo 1

sections.title: Method
sections.content_md:
ShadowFormer is a lightweight, single-stage transformer-based network designed for end-to-end image shadow removal. It employs a multi-scale encoder-decoder architecture utilizing channel attention to efficiently capture hierarchical global information. At the bottleneck stage, a novel Shadow-Interaction Module (SIM) with Shadow-Interaction Attention (SIA) is introduced to model the global contextual correlation between shadow and non-shadow regions, thereby ensuring illumination consistency and reducing boundary artifacts.

**Key Formulas:**

- $$ \mathbf{I}_{s} = \mathbf{I}_m \odot \mathbf{L}_{s} \odot \mathbf{R} + (1-\mathbf{I}_m) \odot \mathbf{L}_{ns} \odot \mathbf{R} $$
  The Retinex-based shadow model decomposing the shadow image into shadow and non-shadow regions based on illumination and reflectance.
- $$ \text{SIA}(\mathbf{X}, \mathbf{\Sigma}) = \text{softmax}(\frac{\mathbf{Q}\mathbf{K}^T}{d})\mathbf{V} $$
  The Shadow-Interaction Attention mechanism that reweights the standard attention map using a correlation map to emphasize context between shadow and non-shadow patches.
- $$ \tilde{\mathbf{X}}= \text{SIA}(\text{CA}(\text{LN}(\mathbf{X})),\mathbf{\Sigma})+ \mathbf{X} $$
  The residual connection formulation within the Shadow-Interaction Module, combining channel attention, layer normalization, and shadow interaction attention.

sections.title: Contributions
sections.content_md:
- **[theory]** We introduce a Retinex-based shadow model, which formulates the degradation of shadow and motivates us to exploit the global contexts for shadow removal.
- **[method]** We propose a new single-stage transformer for shadow removal (ShadowFormer) based on the multi-scale channel attention framework.
- **[method]** We propose a Shadow-Interaction Module with Shadow-Interaction Attention in the ShadowFormer to exploit the global contextual correlation between shadow and non-shadow regions.
- **[application]** The comprehensive experimental results on the public ISTD, ISTD+, and SRD datasets show that the proposed ShadowFormer achieved a new state-of-the-art performance with a very lightweight network, i.e., using up to 150x fewer model parameters.

The channel attention transformer-based encoder and decoder are to extract hierarchical information from the input shadow image, and to reconstruct the shadow-free image, respectively, using a series of channel attention (CA) modules. In the bottleneck stage, we adopt a Shadow-Interaction Module (SIM) to exploit the context information across both spatial and channel dimensions from non-shadow region to help shadow region restoration.

The detailed architectures of ShadowFormer model components. (a) Channel Attention (CA) Module in the encoder and decoder. (b) Shadow-Interaction Module (SIM), as well as an illustration of Shadow-Interaction Attention (SIA).
